data.name: Jawahirah
data.gender_notes: Jawahirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The owner of precious gems, pearls. The name Jawahirah carries the meaning “Jewels, Pearls” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jawahirah usually hope their child will grow to embody jewels, pearls and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the inner beauty and spiritual wealth of a person
data.etymology: Jawahirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewels, Pearls.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawahirah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hindi.name: जवाहिरह

in_english.name: Jawahirah
in_english.long_meaning: Jawahirah is an Arabic name that means beautiful and noble woman, and it includes meanings such as virtue, perfection, and beauty, which are highly valued in Islamic tradition and culture, and is derived from the Arabic root j-w-h-r

data.cultural_impact: The name Jawahirah, derived from the Arabic language, brings to mind the images of rare and beautiful precious gems and pearls. In Arab and Islamic culture, the concepts of beauty, rarity, and value have deep significance. The name Jawahirah often evokes thoughts of wealth, prosperity, and excellence. It can serve as an inspiring reminder of the importance of striving for personal and collective accomplishments that are rare, precious, and worthy of admiration in a world where such things are becoming increasingly rare.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Jawahirah can be understood to mean the possession of inner beauty and worth. Just as gems and precious metals are admired for their value and rarity, the human soul possesses a unique and priceless value that is often unseen due to the veils of physical appearance and material wealth. By taking on this name, one is reminded to strive for the cultivation of inner virtues and to preserve one's spiritual riches, for they are truly the most valuable possessions in this life and the next. Moreover, it may also serve as a reminder of the utterly unique nature of each individual soul and the immeasurable worth each possesses as a creation of Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Jewels, Pearls" symbolizes The owner of precious gems, pearls. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jawahirah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of jewels, pearls.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Jawahirah bint Abd al-Aziz ibn Marwan was a daughter of the Umayyad Caliph Marwan I (r. 685-692 CE).

trends: Trending in Muslim baby name searches
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jawahirah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
